title: Which guidance applies to Local Cache and Disk Usage?

question.author: member_280
question.body: There seem to be different descriptions of local cache and disk usage. What is the maintained CloudBox guidance?

answers.author: cloudbox_support
answers.body: The current Sync Engine documentation says: The client keeps a local cache of recently changed blocks to make syncs faster; this cache can grow large on busy folders. You can clear it at any time under Settings > Advanced without affecting your files. The cache never counts against your CloudBox storage quota — it is a local, per-device artifact only. That official page is the source to follow if a community reply describes an older version. Check the complete section there for surrounding conditions before applying it to your case.
